evidence: The Bi2O3 ultrathin films were synthesized on silicon substrates by ALD (Sunale R-75, Picosun Oy) process. Bi(thd)3 and H2O were used as bismuth and oxygen precursor, respectively. High-purity nitrogen (99.9995%) was used as the sources carrier and purging gas. The carrier gas flow rate for bismuth precursor and water was 150 and 200 sccm (standard cubic centimeters per minute), respectively. Experimental conditions for the ALD deposition of Bi2O3 films are summarized in Table 1. The Bi(thd)3 pulse time was fixed at 6 s (the reason is mentioned below). The Bi2O3 thin films exhibit light yellow color (inset of Figure 5).
